Three Curated Journeys

Elevation Edit
8 Days Morocco Solo or Group

The Desert Surge

Marrakech · Atlas Mountains · Sahara

Medinas at dawn. Mountain trails at altitude. A luxury desert camp under more stars than you've ever seen. Adventure and opulence don't negotiate — here, they coexist.

Elevation Edit
6 Days Costa Rica

The Canopy Reset

Cloud Forests · Pacific Coast

Zip-line through the canopy. Surf at sunrise. Return to a rainforest eco-lodge with a plunge pool and a chef. Adventure that actually restores — not depletes.

View This Itinerary
Elevation Edit
9 Days Greece

The Island Elevation

Santorini · Milos · Open Water

Two islands. One private sailboat charter. Hidden coves that don't appear on maps. Dinner in a cave at sunset. Luxury and aliveness — why would you ever choose one?

The Solstice Collection

Travel that holds space

Three Curated Journeys

Solstice Collection
10 Days Japan Solo

The Still Point

Kyoto · Nara · Hakone

Ancient temples. Ryokan mornings with no agenda. Forest bathing in Arashiyama. Japan has a word — ma — for the pause between what was and what comes next. This trip is built inside that pause.

View This Itinerary
Solstice Collection
7 Days Mexico

The Slow Burn

Oaxaca City · Sierra Norte

Mezcal tastings at dusk. Markets that move at your pace. A temazcal ceremony in the mountains that asks everything of you and gives back something you didn't know you'd lost. Transformation, unhurried.

View This Itinerary
Solstice Collection
8 Days Indonesia

The Recalibration

Ubud · Canggu · Sidemen

Rice terraces at dawn. A private villa with a pool that overlooks the jungle. Sound healing. Breathwork. Long meals. Bali doesn't rush you — and right now, that's exactly what you need.

5 Days Northern Italy

The Vineyard Retreat

The Application

You Tell Us Who You Are

A short intake form — intentional questions about your travel history, what restoration means to you, and what kind of experience you're ready for. You hear from us within 48 hours.

02

The Curation

We Build Your Journey

A one-on-one call. Then a custom itinerary drafted around you — not a template with your name on it. Vendor relationships, logistics, revisions. Every detail handled.

03

The Experience

You Travel With Assurance

Concierge access throughout. A pre-trip briefing. Real-time support if you need it. You show up. Everything else was already thought through.

Ready When You Are

These itineraries are
a starting point.

Your version is built around you — your chapter, your energy, your idea of what restored actually feels like.
